## User guidance notes

- The visualisations and breakdowns below are experimental and for NHS England's internal use only. Data presented was reported in `r reporting_quarter`.
- Several breakdowns of the data are presented throughout the report. **Always check the size of numerators and denominators behind a percentage.** The more granular a breakdown, the higher the chances of obtaining 0% and 100% values due to small group sizes.
- PSC overview charts for every component have been "centred" to allow comparisons of adoption maturity between PSC's. This means the middle of the chart is a focal point that represents the most common stage reported. Bars will sway to the right or left of that focal point to reflect adoption progress. Bars leaning towards the right-hand side of the chart suggest more mature adoption, whilst bars leaning to the left suggest less mature adoption.
- To get the best experience out of this interactive report, **please make sure you are opening a local html file copy of this file.** Do not open this report directly on SharePoint. Instead, hover over the file name and click the `...` icon to download a copy of the file. Then open from your downloads folder, which should display the file in your browser.

## Stages of adoption across adult units

```{r}
# function to aggregate spefic component by stage
national_all_phases <- function(df, component, exclude){
  # quote
  component <- enquo(component)
  
  national_all_phases <- df |>
    # exclude these from percentage calculation
    filter(!!component != exclude) |>
    tabyl(!!component) |>
    rename('Number of sites' = n, 'Percent' = percent, 'Stage' = !!component) 

  # stage check to show all stages in  tables
  all_possible_stages <- c('Stage 0 - No contact',
                           'Stage 1 - Knowledge',
                           'Stage 2 - Interest',
                           'Stage 3 - Decision',
                           'Stage 4 - Testing or Implementation',
                           'Stage 5 - Adoption',
                           'Stage 6 - Spread',
                           'Stage 7 - Sustained')
  
  # this is a tibble that has the stages not shown in aggregation by tabyl
  stages_zero_values <- tibble(Stage = all_possible_stages,
                              `Number of sites` = 0, 
                               Percent = 0) |>
    # we only keep what's not shown by tabyl
    filter(!Stage %in% national_all_phases$Stage)

  national_all_phases_tidy <- national_all_phases |>
    # add rows with zero values
    bind_rows(stages_zero_values)|>
    arrange(Stage) |>
    # add totals and format percentages
    adorn_totals('row') |>
    mutate(Percent = label_percent(accuracy = 0.1)(Percent))
    
  
  national_all_phases_tidy
}

adults_comp_1 <- national_all_phases(df = adults_paeds_to_aggregate, 
                    component = adults_patient_check_in,
                    exclude = 'No adult patients'
                    )

total_sites_adult_units <- adults_comp_1 |> 
  filter(Stage == 'Total') |> 
  pull(`Number of sites`)
```

**Note:** The graphs and tables presented below include only sites that have adult units. Therefore, the total presented for this section (n = `r total_sites_adult_units`) is smaller than the total number of all Martha's Rule sites (n = `r total_sites`)

```{r}
# function to aggregate by phase and component
national_by_phase <- function(df, component, exclude){
  # quote variable
  component <- enquo(component)
  
  national_by_phase <- df |>
    # exclude these from percentage calculation
    filter(!!component != exclude
           ) |>
    group_by(Phase, !!component) |>
    summarise(number_of_sites = n()) |>
    ungroup() |>
    group_by(Phase) |>
    mutate(group_size_by_phase = sum(number_of_sites)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    arrange(!!component )
  
  national_by_phase
}

# function to plot aggregated table from national_by_phase()
plot_national_by_phase <- function(df, component){
  
  # quote variable
  component <- enquo(component)
  
  plot_national_by_phase <- ggplot(
    data = df,
    aes(
      x = number_of_sites,
      y = factor(!!component)
      )
    ) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill = #fct_rev(factor(Phase))),
                 factor(Phase)),
           stat = 'identity',
           # preserve width of bars, even when there's no data for one group
           position = position_dodge(preserve = 'single')) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#801650', '#28A197'),
                    labels = c('Phase 1', 'Phase 2')  # custom legend labels
                    )+
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_wrap(25)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(colour ="black", size = 14),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_line(colour ="grey"),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(colour ="black", size = 14),
        legend.position = 'top',
        legend.justification = 'left',
        legend.location = 'plot'
        )
  
  plot_national_by_phase
}
```

```{r}
below_stage_x <- function(df, component, exclude, stage_filter = '(?i)stage (0|1|2|3)'){
  
  component <- enquo(component)

  below_stage_x <- df |>
    filter(!!component != exclude,
           str_detect(!!component , stage_filter)) |>
    select(
      any_of(c('PSC', 'name_trust_code', 'name_site_code', 'Phase')),
      !!component
      ) |>
    rename('Trust'= name_trust_code,
          'Site' = name_site_code) |>
    #arrange(!!component, Phase, PSC)
    arrange(!!component, across(any_of(c('Phase', 'PSC'))))
  
  below_stage_x
    
}

below_stage_x(df = adults_paeds_to_aggregate, 
              component = adults_patient_check_in,
              exclude = 'No adult patients'
              ) |>
  rename('Component 1' = adults_patient_check_in) |>
  kable()
```

```{r}
# this will allow colours to remain fixed by stage, even when we split vis by phase
fixed_colours <- setNames(
  object = c("#D73027", "#F46D43", "#FDAE61", "#FEE08B", "#D9EF8B", "#A6D96A", "#66BD63", "#1A9850"),
  nm = c('Stage 0 - No contact', 'Stage 1 - Knowledge', 'Stage 2 - Interest', 'Stage 3 - Decision',
         'Stage 4 - Testing or Implementation', 'Stage 5 - Adoption', 'Stage 6 - Spread', 
         'Stage 7 - Sustained')
  )

# graph each component as a likert scale
likert_component <- function(df, component, exclude, by_phase = NULL){
  
  component <- enquo(component)
  
  if (is.null(by_phase)) {
    psc_all_phases <- df |>
      select(PSC, name_site_code, !!component) |>
      # exclude these from percentage calculation
      filter(!!component != exclude) |>
      # note change from quoted component to local component
      mutate(component = factor(!!component))

    psc_for_likert <- psc_all_phases
    } else if (by_phase == 'Phase 1') {
      psc_phase_1 <- df |>
        # exclude these from percentage calculation
        filter(!!component != exclude,
               Phase == '1') |>
        select(PSC, name_site_code, !!component) |>
        # note change from quoted component to local component
        mutate(component = factor(!!component))
      
      psc_for_likert <- psc_phase_1
    } else if (by_phase == 'Phase 2') {
      psc_phase_2 <- df |>
        # exclude these from percentage calculation
        filter(!!component != exclude,
               Phase == '2') |>
        select(PSC, name_site_code, !!component) |>
        # note change from quoted component to local component
        mutate(component = factor(!!component))
      
      psc_for_likert <- psc_phase_2
      }
  
  psc_for_likert

  psc_all_phases_likert <- psc_for_likert |>
    select(-!!component) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = PSC,
                values_from = component)

  plot <- gglikert(psc_all_phases_likert |>
             # drop so we can graph by PSC correctly
             select(-name_site_code),
             # exclude second set of percentages to the sides
             add_totals = F,
             labels_size = 4.5
           ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = fixed_colours
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = T))+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_text(colour ="black", size = 14),
          legend.text = element_text(colour ="black", size = 14),
          legend.position = 'top',
          legend.justification = 'left',
          legend.location = 'plot'
          )

  plot
}
```

```{r}
psc_all_phases_table <- function(df, component, exclude){
  component <- enquo(component)

  psc_all_phases_table <- df |>
    # exclude these from percentage calculation
    filter(!!component != exclude) |>
    group_by(PSC, !!component, .drop = F) |>
    summarise(`Number of sites` = n()) |>
    ungroup() |>
    group_by(PSC) |>
    mutate(`Sites in PSC` = sum(`Number of sites`),
           Percent = `Number of sites`/`Sites in PSC`,
           Percent = label_percent(accuracy = 0.1)(Percent)
           ) |>
    ungroup()

  psc_all_phases_table
}

psc_all_phases_table(df = adults_paeds_to_aggregate,
                     component = adults_patient_check_in,
                     exclude = 'No adult patients'
                     ) |>
  rename('Component 1' = adults_patient_check_in) |>
  DT::datatable(options = list(pageLength = 10))
```

```{r}
# new functions for matneo and ED data
# function to plot aggregated table from national_all_phases()
plot_national <- function(df){

  plot_national <- ggplot(
    data = df |> filter(Stage != 'Total'),
    aes(
      x = `Number of sites`,
      y = factor(Stage)
      )
    ) +
  geom_bar( #aes(fill = factor(Phase)),
           stat = 'identity',
           fill = '#8c96c6'
           # preserve width of bars, even when there's no data for one group
           #position = position_dodge(preserve = 'single')
           ) +
  scale_fill_manual(#values = c('#801650', '#28A197'),
                    #labels = c('Phase 1', 'Phase 2')  # custom legend labels
                    ) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_wrap(25)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(colour ="black", size = 14),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_line(colour ="grey"),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(colour ="black", size = 14),
        legend.position = 'top',
        legend.justification = 'left',
        legend.location = 'plot'
        )
  
  plot_national
}
```

## All adult data

::: {style="width: 55vw;"}
```{r}
# stages to colour
stages <- c('Stage 0 - No contact', 'Stage 1 - Knowledge', 'Stage 2 - Interest')

adults_paeds_to_aggregate |>
  select(PSC, name_trust_code, name_site_code, 
         Phase, matches('adults')) |>
  rename('Trust' = name_trust_code, 
         'Site' = name_site_code,
         'Component 1' = adults_patient_check_in,
         'Component 2' = adults_independent_clinical_review,
         'Component 3' = adults_escalation_available_to_patient_carers
         ) |>
    DT::datatable(options = 
                    list(pageLength = 10,
                         columnDefs = list(
                           list(width = '110px', targets = c(2, 3)),
                           list(width = '50px', targets = c(4)),
                           list(width = '80px', targets = c(5, 6, 7))
                           )
                         )
                  ) |>
    DT::formatStyle(
      columns = c('Component 1', 'Component 2','Component 3'),
      backgroundColor = styleEqual(
        levels = stages,
        c('#D73027', '#F46D43', '#FDAE61')
      )
    ) 
```
:::

::: {style="width: 55vw;"}
